## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c53003ae1962f591bbe14f551ac25a4c6399c505`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md + packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential-actions.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts (`list_platform_admins`), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user-platform-admin-roster-action.test.ts, packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts (`revoke_api_key` / `restore_api_key`), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/index.ts and every `*.object.ts` beside it (the count), packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-admin.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts (`systemObjectActionExposureError`, `actionConfirmationRefusal`), docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md (§Status-line pointers), triage comment 6692886264 on #31032

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set: unchanged.** The PR's file list is one path, `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`, and the GitHub diff is byte-identical to `git diff origin/main pr-31209 -- docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` (+24 / -10). No `packages/**`, no schema, no gate, no test moves, so no accept set of any published package changes. Right.
- **Public surface: none.** No package is published by the diff; no API-surface or d.ts artifact is touched. The two `Check Changeset` runs on the head are `success` with the `skip-changeset` label. Right.
- **What the diff implies about the tree, each checked against the head:** (a) `sys_scim_connection_credential.mint_scim_credential` declares no `ai` block — true (`sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts`, the action carries the bucket-H note and no `ai` key); (b) `revoke_scim_credential` declares `ai: { exposed: true, description, requiresConfirmation: true }` — true; (c) both are `type: 'api'` forwarding under `/api/v1/auth/` (`/admin/scim/mint-credential`, `/admin/scim/revoke-credential`) — true, so the "36 to the routes under `/api/v1/auth/`" and "`revoke_api_key` to the REST data route" split holds (37 = 36 + 1); (d) `sys_user.list_platform_admins` exists, declares no `ai` block, and its source comment reads exactly "No `ai` block: this action postdates the ADR-0011 identity-actions assessment, and an unassessed action stays human-only." — true (`sys-user.object.ts` lines 610-612); (e) the two runtime symbols the addendum cites, `systemObjectActionExposureError` and `actionConfirmationRefusal` (with the 428 `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` refusal), exist on the head in `packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts` — true; (f) PR #31119 is merged at `a794e32c9b22915a5a03596531b1e2ca9a35efa6` (2026-11-07T14:04Z), an ancestor of `origin/main` — true; PR #29427 merged 2026-11-02 — true. All right.
- **Gate verdicts (check-runs on the head, read 2026-11-07 after 17:50Z):** 24 `success`, 25 `skipped`, 0 failures; one still `in_progress`: `Test Core (1/8)`. Every docs-facing gate (`Check Documentation Links`, `Lint · docs & code guards` and the other Lint/Type Check families, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Changeset`) is green. The dev's 21-family derived sweep matches what the head's check-runs cover; nothing was re-run here.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the diff publishes nothing from any released package (one ADR file). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body match the diff — no spec key, accepted value or metadata type moves, and no refusal is added or removed; the ADR's own text says "No rule text moves", and the hunks bear that out (only the two amendment blockquotes, the three name lists, the count sentences and the Not-assessed paragraph change). No `(widening)` / `(narrowing)` arm, so no dogfood battery is owed. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev deviation 1 — thread effort `high` under the `xhigh` floor for `docs/adr/**`.** Recorded on the claim (6710561423) by the seat, not changed by the dev; the named compensating control is this at-tier review. Answered: the diff is 24 added lines of record whose every claim is checkable by reading the tree, and this review checked each one (④). No residual.
- **Dev deviation 2 — one more name than the card asked for (`sys_user.list_platform_admins` in Not-assessed).** Answered: right. The tree holds 62 actions on 13 identity objects, the card counted 61; recording the 62nd outside every bucket, as the addendum's own rule puts an unassessed action, is the only move that keeps the table complete without the dev ruling a bucket. Silently folding it into H would have been the dev's ruling, and leaving it unnamed would have left the table understating the tree again, which is the drift the card was filed against.
- **Dev deviation 3 — eslint ignores `.md`.** Answered: not a gap; the docs gates on the head are the style authority and are green.
- **Open question — the bucket of `sys_user.list_platform_admins` (A leave unassessed / B assess E with an `ai` block / C assess H).** Answered for this PR: A holds. The addendum says a bucket is a maintainer ruling and an unassessed action stays human-only; the action's own source declares the same, and `sys-user-platform-admin-roster-action.test.ts` pins `ai` undefined. B or C is a maintainer ruling that lands as a follow-up amendment plus the `ai` block; nothing in this PR forecloses either. Escalated, not blocking: the seat should put A-vs-B to the maintainer at hand-over (the H test — minting, ownership, sign-in, destruction — names none of what a roster read does, so E is the natural reading if an agent ever needs the roster).
- **Out-of-scope note — no Status-line pointer for the amendment.** Answered: no finding. ADR-0146's "Status-line pointers" section is the convention for a record amended or superseded in part by ANOTHER ADR (the eight pointers read "Amended by [ADR-0146]" / "Superseded in part by [ADR-0146]"); an ADR's own dated amendment inside its own addendum is not that case, and ADR-0011's 2026-10-31 amendment carries none either. No gate reads a pointer (`adr-index.mjs` parses the Status keyword and `Superseded by` only).
- **Open-ended flag in the triage (comment 6707830626): "It may also ride that PR if the seat prefers."** Moot: PR #31119 landed first and the record follows it, as the card's "Blocked by" required.

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` — an ADR addendum amendment, judged against its first consumer (the two actions on `sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts` and the test that pins them) and its execution plan (the addendum's own rule: the table is the only record a reviewer of `identity/**` reads, so it must match the tree). Every number and quotation was verified on the PR head by reading the tree (`git show pr-31209:...` and a text parse of the `actions: [...]` blocks of all 33 `*.object.ts` files under `identity/`; nothing was built, imported or executed).

- **Counts, verified against the tree:** 13 of the 33 identity objects declare actions; 62 actions; 37 `ai` blocks; 25 without an `ai` block; 18 `exposed + requiresConfirmation`; 19 `exposed` without confirmation; 0 `ai` blocks that are unexposed. Set comparison of the amended lists against the tree: H lists 24 names = tree's 25 minus `sys_user.list_platform_admins` (the one the Not-assessed paragraph names); C lists 18 = 18; E lists 19 = 19; no ADR-only name, no duplicate. So "61 assessed actions and 37 `ai` blocks (H 24 / C 18 / E 19); the tree holds one more identity action, unassessed" is exact, and "the one identity action that postdates the assessment and is in no bucket above" is exact (it is the only unlisted one).
- **The 36 → 37 and 35 → 36 sentences:** all 37 E+C actions are `type: 'api'`; 36 forward to targets under `/api/v1/auth/` and the one exception is `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` → `/api/v1/data/sys_api_key/{id}`. Both moved sentences are right. The "better-auth routes" wording is pre-existing imprecision (the two SCIM mounts, like `admin/sso/*` and `admin/oauth2/toggle-disabled` already counted there, are plugin-auth's own platform-admin doors); the behaviour the paragraph records holds for them too: `scim-connection-admin.ts` says the `judgePlatformAdmin` gate runs before the module reads anything and an anonymous caller is answered 401. Not a finding.
- **Quoted triage lines:** "Classify mint as not exposed to AI tools" and "Revoke may be classified on its own merits" are verbatim in comment 6692886264 on #31032 (os-zhuang's triage, 2026-11-06). `a794e32c9b` is PR #31119's merge commit on `origin/main`. The 2026-10-31 amendment, the "58 actions in 38 blocks" history and the maintainer's struck-check quotation are untouched.
- **Bucket judgments against the ADR's own tests:** mint H — "it mints a credential" is the first H test word for word, and the first consumer agrees (the object's note, and `sys-scim-connection-credential-actions.test.ts` refuses any `ai.exposed` on mint). Revoke C — a destructive lifecycle act with no credential handed out and no privilege widened, bounded to one connection; `revoke_session` (also irreversible) sits in C on the same reading, and the consumer test pins `{ exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true }`. Both hold.
- **should-fix — the revoke reason's analogy.** The amendment reads "switches one bearer off and cannot be undone, as `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` does". On the head, `revoke_api_key` CAN be undone: `sys_api_key.restore_api_key` is in the H list of this same addendum, and `revoke_api_key`'s own `ai.description` says "It can be restored later." The object's source comment makes the comparison only for "switches one bearer off" (naming `revoke_api_key` and `revoke_session`); the ADR's sentence attaches it to "cannot be undone" as well, which is false of the API key and contradicts the H list a few lines above. One-sentence fix: "switches one bearer off, as `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` and `sys_session.revoke_session` do; it cannot be undone and its reach is that one connection, so it is C under the bounded arm." The lists, counts and buckets — the record — are unaffected, so this does not fail the PR.
- **Noted, no finding:** the addendum's opening sentence still says the actions "on the twelve identity objects" were assessed; thirteen objects now declare actions. The sentence describes the 2026-10-30 assessment and is not touched by this diff; the 2026-11-07 amendment names the thirteenth object explicitly, so a reader is not misled.
- **No sibling record goes stale:** a sweep of `docs/`, `content/`, `AGENTS.md`, `.claude/` and package sources for "59 actions", "36 `ai` blocks", "H 23", "36 E and C", "All 36 are", "35 to the better-auth" finds no other carrier of the old counts; ADR-0066 D4's 2026-10-30 note cites the mechanism, not the count.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `f557345434c357fb35dd8d176ed77428bd3583d6`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md + packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-admin.ts (the revoke mount's `409`), packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-connection-service.ts (`mintScimConnectionCredential`, `revokeScimConnectionCredential`), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts (`apiMethods`, `managedBy`, the revoke `confirmText`), packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts (`revoke_api_key` / `restore_api_key`), every non-test writer of `sys_scim_connection_credential` on the head (swept)

### ① Derived judgments

- **Delta review over record 6710882534** (the PASS on `c53003ae1962f591bbe14f551ac25a4c6399c505`, posted 2026-11-07T17:47Z). The new head adds one commit, `f5573454` "docs(adr): ADR-0011 amendment note grounds revoke_scim_credential's C bucket on boundedness", and `git diff c53003ae…pr-31209-b` is one file, `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`, +4 / -2, confined to the 2026-11-07 amendment blockquote. Every judgment of 6710882534 outside that blockquote stands unchanged: no identity object, test, gate or script moves between the two heads, so the lists (H 24 / C 18 / E 19), the count sentences (61 assessed / 37 `ai` blocks; 37 and 36), the Not-assessed paragraph and the quoted triage lines are as verified there. The PR's file list is still one path; the GitHub head is `f557345434…`, still draft, labels unchanged.
- **Accept set and public surface: unchanged and none.** The delta publishes nothing and changes no rule text; it rewrites the reason sentence of one amendment. Right.
- **Gate verdicts (check-runs on the new head, read within minutes of the push):** 37 runs so far — 6 `success` (`filter`, `Check PR Size`, `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`), 16 `skipped`, 0 failures, and **15 `in_progress`**: every Lint and Type Check family (`Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the three `Lint · scoped` jobs, `Type Check · workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger`), `Plan Test Core shards`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Auto Label`; the `Test Core` shards had not been planned yet. On the prior head the same families all completed green with `Test Core (1/8)` the last in flight; the delta is prose in one ADR, so nothing in it can turn a family that was green. The seat should confirm green before landing.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from 6710882534: `skip-changeset` is right for a docs-only diff that publishes nothing; `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body still match (`Check Changeset` is `success` on the new head). Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **The should-fix of 6710882534** ("cannot be undone, as `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` does" attached irreversibility to an action the same H list shows is restorable): answered by the delta. The comparison to `revoke_api_key` now attaches only to "switches one bearer off", the bounded arm of the C test is stated ("bounded to that one connection"), and the irreversibility claim is grounded on the tree rather than on an analogy. Closed.
- **The dev's measurement claim** ("no door restores a revoked SCIM credential; the revoke door answers 409 on an already-revoked row; the only `active: true` write is the mint"): verified on the head, see ④. The dev's account was not relied on.
- No new dev flag, deviation or open question is raised by the delta; the open question on `sys_user.list_platform_admins` and the other flags answered in 6710882534 stand as answered there (A holds for this PR; A-vs-B is the maintainer's to rule at hand-over).

### ④ Design judgment

`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` — the rewritten reason sentence of the 2026-11-07 amendment, judged against the code it now cites.

- **"it switches one bearer off, as `sys_api_key.revoke_api_key` does"** — true and now correctly scoped: `revokeScimConnectionCredential` (`scim-connection-service.ts`, line 365) is `engine.update(SCIM_CREDENTIAL_OBJECT, { id, active: false })` on the one row; `revoke_api_key`'s own `ai.description` describes the same switch-off ("every client using it loses access immediately. It can be restored later"), and the sentence no longer claims the API key is irreversible.
- **"bounded to that one connection"** — true: a credential row carries one `connection_id` (object field, `required: true`), the revoke writes that one row, and `verifyScimBearerToken` refuses on `active` per row (service lines 299-301). This is the "bounded" arm of the ADR's own C test, so the bucket is now grounded in the test's words rather than by analogy.
- **"the revoke door answers `409` on one already revoked"** — true: `scim-connection-admin.ts` line 387-388, `if (outcome.outcome === 'already_revoked') return fail(409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT', …'is already revoked; nothing changed')`; the service reports `already_revoked` for any row not affirmatively active (lines 360-362) and does not write it again.
- **"the only write of `active: true` is the mint"** — true on the head: the single `active: true` in plugin-auth is the `engine.insert` inside `mintScimConnectionCredential` (service line 256); the only other write to the object anywhere in non-test package sources is the revoke's `active: false` (swept every non-test site naming `sys_scim_connection_credential` / `SCIM_CREDENTIAL_OBJECT`: translations, constants, CLI inventory, comments, and these two). The generic data path cannot flip it either: the object declares `managedBy: 'engine-owned'` and `enable.apiMethods: ['list']`. No restore action exists on the object, and the object's revoke `confirmText` says the same ("This cannot be undone: to restore provisioning, mint a new credential").
- **"so provisioning resumes only by minting a new one"** — follows from the above and matches the mount header's "Rotation is not a third operation" paragraph.
- **Shape:** the blockquote keeps its "Amended (2026-11-07, #31124 …)" opener and "The lists below are the amended record." closer; the mint sentence and both triage quotations are untouched; the paragraph introduces no tracker number beyond those already there and no angle-bracket or tag-shaped fragment. Nothing elsewhere in the file changes.
- No must-fix and no new should-fix. The "twelve identity objects" historical sentence noted in 6710882534 remains as noted there, not a finding.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：ADR-0011「平台身份动作」附录补记 #31032（PR #31119）新增的两个 SCIM 凭据动作：`mint_scim_credential` 进 H 档（仅人工，无 `ai` 块），`revoke_scim_credential` 进 C 档（暴露给 AI，但必须人工确认），并写明它进 C 档的理由：只关掉一个凭据、不发凭据也不扩权限，且吊销后没有任何入口能恢复。计数按当前 `main` 实测重写：已评估 61 个、`ai` 块 37 个（H 24 / C 18 / E 19）。
- 为什么改：这张表是审阅 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/**` 时判断「哪些平台身份动作 AI 能跑」的唯一记录（自动检查已被否决）。#31119 合入后表里少了这两个动作。
- 风险与回滚：只改一个 ADR 文件（+26/−10），不改规则句、不加门禁、不发布包（`skip-changeset`）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`：新增的 2026-11-07 amendment 引文块；H / C 两个列表末尾的新名字与计数；「Not assessed」段新增的 `list_platform_admins` 一句。
- 两分钟验证：对照 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-scim-connection-credential.object.ts`：`mint_scim_credential` 无 `ai` 块，`revoke_scim_credential` 的 `ai` 是 `exposed: true, requiresConfirmation: true`。
- 需要你做的：批准或直接合并本 PR（Tier H，`docs/adr/**`）。Fable 契约复审 PASS 6711023559，Head-sha `f557345434`。另有一个可选裁决：`sys_user.list_platform_admins`（PR #29427）晚于评估，本 PR 记为「未评估 = 仅人工」；席位建议保持这样，要归档请另开卡。

席位意见：建议批准。表与代码一致，第一轮复审指出的类比错误（拿可恢复的 API key 吊销作比）已改为按「有界、不可恢复」立论，增量复审确认没有入口能恢复已吊销的 SCIM 凭据。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:server#5` · Head-sha `f557345434c357fb35dd8d176ed77428bd3583d6` · 2026-11-07T18:12Z

- **Shape:** 1 file, `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md`, +26/−10, read from the diff. Commits: `2096b75721` (addendum), `c53003ae19` (merge of `origin/main`), `f557345434` (amendment note reworded per review S1).
- **Premise measured:** `Blocked-by: #31032` closed (PR #31119 merged). On main the two actions' `ai` blocks are as the addendum states; counts are the dev's re-measure, confirmed by the at-tier review.
- **Review:** CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER (fable) full review PASS 6710882534 on `c53003ae19`, one should-fix (the `revoke_api_key` analogy: that key is restorable). Fixed in `f557345434`; delta review PASS 6711023559 on this head, which checked that no door restores a revoked SCIM credential. No must-fix open.
- **Gates:** head check-runs 26 `success`, 19 skipped, none red or pending. `check-expected-skips`: OK, all 19 in main's roster (exit 0). `check-governed-merges`: GOVERNED, `docs/adr/**` ×1, Tier H, 36 changed lines ≤ 3000. The dev's `dispatch-gates --commands`: 21 run, all exit 0. Mergeable state `clean`.
- **Accepted deviation:** the card thread ran at the thread default effort, not the xhigh floor of a fable-tier card (recorded in the claim); compensating control is the at-tier review above.
- **Out of scope:** `list_platform_admins` left unassessed, recorded in the ADR; bucketing it is a maintainer call (see 速读). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `Skills-docs:` n/a. `skip-changeset` (docs only).
